name: iFizBox
subtitle: A package manager with the iOS 6 look
description: iFizBox's own source: the iFizBox app for iPhones without a jailbreak.

apps.name: iFizBox
apps.subtitle: Packages and apps with the iOS 6 look
apps.localizedDescription: iFizBox lists apps from AltStore-style sources and, on a jailbroken iPhone, tweaks and themes from APT repos, with the iOS 6 look. The app signs apps on your iPhone with your own certificate (no server) and scrolls at 120Hz. Free and open source (GPL-3.0-or-later).

versions.localizedDescription:
Installing works again: the default Signing Server is now sign.ifizbox.com (cydian.dev is gone).
If you set a server by hand, set it to https://sign.ifizbox.com in Settings > Signing.
iFizBox's own updates now show in Changes, without a popup.
User reviews on package pages.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.9.2

Signing no longer fails on apps with an executable-less bundle ("bundle missing" errors, e.g. YTUHD.bundle).
Package pages redone as the iOS 6 App Store's: big icon, stars, screenshots, Details / Reviews / Related.
Install Now right after setting up Signing, and the Signing Server row works again.
Reload shows Cydia's four steps; coming back after a few minutes refreshes sources.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.9.1

Cydian is now iFizBox: new name, new globe icon, new home at ifizbox.com.
The name changed because "Cydia" is SaurikIT's trademark; iFizBox is not affiliated with Cydia or SaurikIT.
New name and icon everywhere in the app and on the website
The website moved to https://ifizbox.com
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.9.0

Browse rebuilt: Featured, New and Top 25, Tweak of the Day, Collections, and Tweak Roulette
Installs show a progress page with a terminal-style log, ending on Open, Respring or Reload
App pages show App Store details, screenshots and links to that app and its source
Drop-down reload bar like Cydia's, with live status and Cancel; it no longer blocks the app
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.5.0

**Home and Settings**
Settings now sits at the bottom of Home, like Cydia; the tab bar is Home, Sources, Changes, Installed and Search.
Settings rebuilt like iOS 6's Settings app: General, Display, Updates, Signing and About. Unused settings removed.
The Signing tile hides once signing is set up (it lives in Settings > Signing).
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.4.0

The website signs apps for real now (the browser signer kept the old signature: integrity could not be verified), shows Ready to Install so iOS asks only once (no Open in iTunes), and leaves app extensions out.
The website pushes Cydian first: Home below Install Cydian App and the other tabs stay locked (Install Cydian, Browse Anyway (5), Cancel; Settings > Signing locks it again); Install Full Cydian for jailbroken phones (Sileo, Zebra, .deb); tweak pages offer Install in Cydian.
Add Source paste works again in the app; Back and the swipe go to the page you came from; the scroll bar takes a hold to grab.
Cydian Account syncs settings, sources, ignored upgrades and the wish list.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.3.8

The website signs and installs apps again, entirely in Safari (zsign as WebAssembly): Settings > Signing, Home's Signing tile and Install Cydian App are back. Website Install offers Install and Download IPA.
Installed shows each signed app's days left (green, amber, red); Changes lists Needs Re-sign; re-signs go through Confirm.
Modify offers Mark as Not Installed.
Settings > Update Alerts uses Cydian's switches: Check in the Background, badge, notifications, Background App Refresh.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.3.7

Icon badge fixed (badge permission is asked for); the background check keeps the badge current and Settings > Update Alerts shows what iOS allows, when it last checked, and a switch to turn background checks off.
Long-press the Cydian icon: Upgrade All (N) queues every upgrade and opens Confirm.
A new Cydian (not required) shows a banner with Upgrade instead of an alert; installed apps show Modify (Upgrade or Reinstall, Downgrade).
Updating Cydian: a banner says it will close, and it closes itself so iOS finishes.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.3.6

Updates are checked every time you come back to Cydian, from a fresh copy of the source.
After you tap Install on an update of Cydian, it closes so iOS can finish, with a notification to open the new version.
The website no longer needs a server of its own: Install hands apps to Cydian or another sideloader.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.3.5

Alerts stack two long buttons (the Essential Upgrade popup).
Home: Reload like Cydia's (spinner in the button); the lower list like Cydia's (User Guides and more).
Jailbreak app: installed apps show their real versions and are recorded when installed.
cydian.dev is now one Cloudflare Worker: the website, its source proxy and the install server; anyone can run their own (worker/README.md).
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.3.4

Essential: Cydian now uses its new install server, sign.cydian.dev (a Cloudflare Worker anyone can host for free: worker/README.md). Signing still happens on your iPhone.
After Cydian updates itself it closes, with a notification to open the new version.
Reload works like Cydia's (spinner in the button, no flash).
More from the runner (I4, F87).
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.3.3

Install, Upgrade and Version History go through Cydia's Confirm and queue; Custom Install for any app (bundle ID, name, icon, extensions); the Essential Upgrade alert queues too.
Confirm looks like Cydia's on the 4S: Continue Queuing, Statistics, Modifications.
Cydian opens AltStore, SideStore and Feather links (Settings to turn it off).
Search: the bar stays put, with iOS 6's clear button.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.3.2

Confirm and queue like Cydia: Install, Upgrade, Reinstall and Upgrade (N) queue apps and open Confirm.
Links into other tabs slide in over the page you are on; Back comes back (Install IPAs from Home).
Install IPAs: a search bar (all apps, or the list you are in).
App pages: the first permissions, then N More Permissions.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.3.1

Install IPAs: browse apps from your sources by category, search them, and keep your own IPAs; linked from Home.
Links into another tab slide in.
Sources Add: while iOS shows Paste, the button reads Type (blue): tap it to type a source in.
Cydian checks for essential updates again when you come back to it.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.3.0

Changes: app upgrades show (Available Upgrades, the tab and icon badge) with Upgrade (N); a background check posts a notification when updates come out.
Sources: Add never sticks pressed; tapping Manage while the Paste bubble is up opens Manage.
Installed: My IPAs as a button at the top.
Install errors say what went wrong.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.2.9

Importing from the website shows one popup (ends on Done); anything that could not be added shows in a passing banner.
A website install brings its settings only on the first launch.
The Home Cydian App card; My IPAs (0.2.7).
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.2.8

My IPAs under Installed: add your own IPAs from Files or a URL, sign them on the phone (offline), install, save or share them.
Home: the Cydian App card (Install Cydian App, Send Settings to App); Featured slides in; the tile says Refreshing Sources while sources load.
Open in Cydian brings your certificate too and imports straight away.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.2.7

Open in Cydian App brings your certificate, sources and settings, and imports them straight away.
Installing Cydian from the website brings all of it along: ready on first launch, nothing to set up.
Home: by Ryan Hayden (Fizlo).
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.2.6

The app opens on a plain fill that fits every iPhone, then its loading screen (no more cut-off launch screen).
Import your certificate from Safari, or get it built into the app from the website; Open in Cydian App moves your sources and settings (F75).
Badges: Changes and the app icon show the upgrade count at launch; sources refresh in the background with the red spinning badge.
Upgrade/Reinstall on app pages, Discord next to GitHub, the banner moves the bars down, outside links open in Safari.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.2.5

Share sheet: Open in … apps on app pages too.
The A–Z index no longer fights a list that is still gliding.
Cydian updates itself in one step (signed on the phone, held on the signing server, then iOS's Install prompt).
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.2.4
